title: Vintage The Rovers Malibu Comics Full Set Issues 1-3, 1993
descriptionText:
The product is a full set of three vintage comic book issues from the indie series "The Rovers" published by Malibu Comics in 1993. The series falls under the science fiction genre and features the character "Rover." This set is a collectible piece for fans of US Comics and comic book enthusiasts looking to add a rare and nostalgic set to their collection.

Set of three vintage Malibu Comics The Rovers issues 1 2 and 3. All comics are bagged and boarded. Covers show light shelf wear consistent with age but present well with no major creases or tears observed. Pages appear clean. Overall very good reader and collector condition.
Description
Complete set of The Rovers from Malibu Comics including issues 1 2 and 3 published in 1993. Indie action series with art by Scott Bieser and story by S A Bennett. Bright covers and classic early 90s Malibu style.
Each comic is stored in a protective sleeve with board. Great for indie comic collectors or anyone filling Malibu runs.
Please review photos carefully as they are part of the description. You will receive the exact comics shown.
